headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis tools to provide more accurate and up-to-date security assessments. Leverage machine learning models for predictive insights into potential vulnerabilities. Implement a user-friendly interface that highlights critical risks during the installation process.
